# Preserved Original Research Decisions

These decisions are preserved separately because each research reset used a different exclusion set and decision objective. They must not be silently overwritten by the repository’s later composite scoring.

- **Winner:** [AgentLingo — Multilingual AI Agent Launch Gate](../ideas/agentlingo-multilingual-ai-agent-launch-gate.md)
- **Runner-up:** [RAG Citation Fidelity Gate](../ideas/rag-citation-fidelity-gate.md)
- **High-upside:** [Model & Prompt Regression Gate](../ideas/model-and-prompt-regression-gate.md)
- **Overlooked:** [MCP Cross-Client Release Gate](../ideas/mcp-cross-client-release-gate.md)
- **Confidence:** moderate
- **Interpretation:** This is the report’s own decision under its exclusions and $0–$100 constraints, not the repository composite ranking.
